name: missing_metadata_inconclusive
description: Uses a table that is not in the catalog; LLM pass -> inconclusive.

execution.sql:
SELECT e.full_name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_spend
FROM card_transactions AS c
JOIN employees AS e ON c.employee_id = e.employee_id
JOIN employee_budgets AS b ON b.employee_id = e.employee_id
GROUP BY e.full_name
